figurative_meaning_en: A wife devoted to her husband
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার স্বামীর চরণদাসী হয়ে জীবন যাপন করে।
গ্রামের এই মেয়েটি বিবাহের পর চরণদাসী হয়ে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: She lives as a devoted wife to her husband.
The village girl became a devoted wife after marriage.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Hindu concepts of pativrata, emphasizing wifely devotion in ancient Bengali literature and folklore.
note: The term reflects patriarchal ideals in Bengali culture, often idealized in stories and proverbs.
